messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — cutoff for the 0.9.3 release is tomorrow 10:00 PDT. We still need final console docs updates and the SDK docs regen. Who is available to handle deploy + SDK docs artifacts?

devon: I can take the console site deploy. Planning to merge the docs PR today into `release/0.9.3-docs`. Can someone confirm changelog is ready before I deploy?

li: I can run the SDK docs regen after your merge, @devon. I'll produce both TS and Python docs. Will need the final version bump in `sdk/package.json` first (0.9.3).

maya: Please also add a one-line changelog entry for the SDK and console under `CHANGELOG.md` on the release branch — it's blocking the release notes automation. @ana can you review changelog entries when they're up?

ana (ana): Yep I'll review. Send the PR link and I'll do a quick pass. Reminder: follow the format `- [component] Short description (#PR)` so the script picks it up.

harper: Small docs note: console telemetry section changed — need to include the new `redwood.telemetry.enabled` flag snippet under "Integrations". Put the snippet in the same PR and tag me for review.

devon: I'll include the telemetry snippet. Deploy plan: merge by 08:45 PDT, run checks, then deploy at ~09:30 PDT to give SDK regen time. Deploy command I’ll run locally: ```bash
npm run deploy:docs -- --branch release/0.9.3-docs
```

sre-bot: FYI — scheduling canary rollout window for docs site at 09:30 PDT. Health checks enabled (3m).

jung: After devon merges, I'll regenerate SDK docs with: ```bash
cd sdk && make docs && npm run publish-docs-artifact -- --version 0.9.3
``` I'll open a PR with artifact links and update the docs index.
final_messages:
deploy-bot: docs deploy succeeded at 09:38 PDT — live at https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/0.9.3 :rocket:

devon: deployed and smoke-tested the console pages, telemetry snippet looks good.

li: SDK docs regen done, PR opened with artifacts and version bump in `sdk/package.json` (#3214).

ana: changelog entry approved and merged. CI passed.

patrick: quick ping to infra: please flush CDN/DNS cache after deploy (cc @sre-team).

sre-bot: CDN purge queued — expect TTL to clear in ~5m.

maya: awesome team — final checklist complete. I’ll kick the release job now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
